Sam: Quick question for payroll timeline/requirementsI'm starting parental leave June 1 for ~12 weeks. What's the deadline to submit paperwork so my first leave paycheck isn't delayed?

Maya (People Ops): Congrats! :confetti_ball: Key dates: for standard payroll processing we need completed leave paperwork + STD claim (if applicable) 10 business days before the first paid leave period. For June 1 start you should submit by May 18.

Hana (Payroll): To add detail: payroll cutoff aligns with our monthly payroll calendar. If STD is being used, the insurance carrier also needs the claim filed ASAP. Missing the 10-day window usually results in the leave pay being processed on the next payroll cycle (1pay period delay).

Sam: Thanks. I'm planning to file for company-paid parental top-up + state disability (CA). How do those interact?

Maya (People Ops): Good call to file both. Flow is: 1) Apply to state disability (or equivalent) -> carrier issues benefit; 2) Submit carrier determination to People Ops -> we calculate top-up to reach company policy level and process through payroll. We need the carrier's determination letter before top-up can be applied.

Hana (Payroll): Practically: upload the carrier docs to the HR portal (https://intra.redwood/hr/leave) and file the internal leave form. We'll flag the payroll entry with a special remittance code so the top-up is paid in the same payroll cycle as carrier payments when possible.

Luis (Manager): Sam, please confirm whether you'll need a partial return (e.g., 60% for 4 weeks) so we can plan headcount and pro-rate top-up.

Sam: Probably yes, 60% for the first 3 weeks back. How does that affect pay?

Hana (Payroll): Partial returns are pro-rated by hours. We'll need the approved partial return memo signed by you, Luis, and People Ops before the payroll cutoff for the pay period that includes the partial weeks.

Maya (People Ops): Also FYI: PTO accrual pauses during unpaid leave but continues for paid leave per policy. If you plan to use accrued PTO to bridge any gap, add that to the leave form.

Sam: What about benefits continuation and premiums?

Maya (People Ops): Health/dental/vision continue if you remain in paid leave status. If you go unpaid we bill you for your employee portion monthly; you can elect COBRA only if you terminate employment. For international teammates the billing model may differ (we'll confirm).

Hana (Payroll): Action items for payroll timing:
- Upload STD/PD carrier docs to HR portal (Sam)
- Submit internal leave form (Sam)
- Confirm partial return dates and hours (Sam + Luis)
- Payroll will create pay entries after docs received and carrier determination attached (Hana)

Sam: Got it. Any docs I should sign today?

Maya (People Ops): Please fill these two links today: 1) Internal leave form: https://intra.redwood/hr/forms/leave-request 2) Authorization to share info with insurer: https://intra.redwood/hr/forms/insurer-auth. I'll drop the fillable PDFs in your email.

Sam: Filling them out now. Also, are there tax implications for the company top-up?

Hana (Payroll): Company top-up is taxable income and will show on your paystub. Carrier disability payments may be taxable depending on jurisdiction; we recommend discussing with a tax advisor. For payroll reporting we'll tag the top-up as "Parental Top-Up" on the stub.

Maya (People Ops): One more cross-check: if you have short-term disability (STD) coordination, you might receive carrier retro payments. We need to reconcile those against top-up so you aren't overpaid. Please forward any retro notices to payroll@redwood.com.

PeopleOpsBot: Leave intake ticket created: HR-7522. Attach STD carrier letter and signed leave form to this ticket.

Sam: Thanks all. Can People Ops confirm the 10-business-day rule in writing so I can calendar it?

Maya (People Ops): Confirmed: submit completed leave form + carrier docs at least 10 business days before your leave start to avoid payroll delay. I'll add that rule to the ticket and DM you a checklist.

Luis (Manager): I'll prepare the partial return approval memo and sign once Sam confirms hours. Also looping recruiting in case we need short-term coverage.

Sam: Appreciate it. Will upload docs by May 17 and update here.

Hana (Payroll): Once uploaded I'll ack on the ticket and confirm estimated payroll date.

Sam: Perfect, thanks everyone :pray:
